description: Run the first final three-trial QKV band
proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,439 parameters at 99.060000%, a +0.060000-point margin. There have been 90 prior macro-attempts and 715 prior micro-trials in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0192/micro-0003 at 1,439/99.06%; the most recent failed result remains attempt-0189/micro-0005 because attempts 190-192 had no failures. Hypothesis: QKV remains compressible after another 20 cross-tensor reductions. The helper adds one ordered eligible QKV union per official micro-trial with runner-only retention/rollback. Stop at first scored discard/error, no pair, three trials, or five minutes. This is more informative than a longer band because the final macro budget is explicitly alternating sites to measure breadth.
summary: Three bounded QKV trials all qualified, reducing the observed retained frontier from 1,439 to 1,436 parameters; the last trial retained 99.130000%. The cap stopped the automation after exactly three official micro-trials.
